digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria and LLM gate logic
propositions: T13 plan-review criterion currently triggers only on prohibitions (forbidden actions); it must be widened to also trigger on newly added obligations (contracts, invariants, schema fields, required arguments, synchronized multi-site commitments) to close a verified residual gap.

The deterministic pre-gate regex in det_gate_rules.py lacks alternation branches for additive-obligation vocabulary, causing obligation-based plans to be det-skipped before reaching the router; a second branch matching obligation phrasings must be added alongside the prohibition lexicon.

Historical analysis of 40 recent CLI-surface commits shows the proposed content-triggered widening of surface-parity would yield 70% false-positive triggers; write-parameter parity is now deterministically tested via the write-parity-oracle contract, making the LLM widening redundant and rejecting the P1 proposal.

The import-integrity criterion (P0) should be implemented deterministically via a full importlib walk of rebar.* in the wheel-probe CI venv plus a scripts/ import leg, rather than as an LLM criterion, consistent with the operator's preference for deterministic checks over LLM gates.
